address: 40 Upper Lascar Row, Sheung Wan, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Mora is located on Cat Street, famous for its antique and junk market. The soothing interior adopts a cream colour scheme with subtle curvy lines. Soybeans are at the core of the menu, taking the forms of bean sauce, tofu skin, soymilk, and fermented beans, whose textures complement other ingredients in each dish well. European techniques are seamlessly melded with local flavours for a varied and interesting experience. Don’t miss their Mapo tofu....
